materiality_analysis.reason: The 2024 filing discloses that an indirect customer represented approximately 19% of total revenue. This is a significant concentration risk, especially as it is linked to Customer A (13%). The 2023 filing stated no customer exceeded 10%. The combination of direct and indirect exposure to a single economic entity totaling ~32% (13% + 19%) represents a material escalation in dependency and risk exposure compared to the prior year.
materiality_analysis.key_change: Significant increase in indirect customer revenue concentration
